label: president or manager of
definition: The first person holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in the second organization, team or public body.
scope_notes: The president family dominates, with a smaller manager family. Preserve the earlier president-or-manager scope. Generic head, chair, executive, director, coach, athlete or ordinary employment alone is insufficient. Functional presidential roles within an organization count without claiming sole chief presidency; modifiers missing from a path cannot be reconstructed.

facts.reason: The Senate/House pair is connected by something being sent by the House to the Senate; neither argument is an officeholder of the other.
Aristide is directly president of Haiti in both appositive and possessive forms.

Berne has explicit president-of and NYU-president paths, with a development function specified in the longer row. This supports the declared office family, not an inference that he is the institution's sole overall president.
Nunn appears in boxing-title defense/postponement and fighting-for-title evidence. Those paths do not make him the federation's president or manager.
Harazin is explicitly president of/for the Mets.
